items.text:
a high tension background music plays and my ship is beeping crazily as if there is no tomorrow.
as i get near to the place the beeping gets faster and faster.
i just want to dock peacefully after tutorial (┬┬﹏┬┬).
items.text_zh:
高紧张度的背景音乐响着，我的飞船疯狂地哔哔作响，仿佛没有明天。
当我靠近那个地方时，哔哔声越来越快。
我只想在教程结束后平静地停靠（┬┬﹏┬┬）。

observations.description: 背景音乐过于紧张，与平静停靠场景不符
observations.evidence: a high tension background music plays and my ship is beeping crazily as if there is no tomorrow.
